scores.reasons: Gap: small - already bookable with priced services; missing phone/contact and own domain. Ability: color-led menu with $120-450 services and deposits, plus 197 reviews. Ease: GlossGenius handles booking, so changes are content and domain work. Evidence: site, service pages, schema and mobile view inspected.

caveats: Google blocks automated access from this environment, so ratings and review counts come from third-party aggregators (Birdeye, Demandforce, ChiropractorDirectories, AcuLocator, LocalityBiz, Magicpin, BestProsInTown) rather than the Google listing itself, and counts differ across those sources.
The browser adds a small emoji prefix to some page titles; titles quoted here were taken from the raw HTML title where it differed.
data_gaps: rebarberchiro.com returned HTTP 403 to the headless browser on three attempts; page content was read via direct fetch, so mobile rendering and JSON-LD could not be checked.
Google Business Profile completeness (claimed status, categories, photos, services) could not be verified for any business.
The Loft Salon and BLOOM sit on platform subdomains where a robots.txt was not readable, so crawler rules for those hosts are unknown.
Fresha profiles for Park Chiropractic and Acupuncture & Natural Healing showed no services or times, so it is unknown whether the owners have claimed them.
